required_agent_checks: Feature branch/package identity and reserved directory correspond; deltas and FEATURE-TASKS exist at convention root paths; unrelated active package preserved.
Named-file range completion does not depend on delivering future stdin. Trace first derived feature dependency to supplied input/pinned guidance; do not coach consumer.
Feature preparation derives its explicit review tasks and final review milestone without activating future phases or incorporating unselected documents; planned report links use the feature prefix.

Selected feature preparation includes adjacent FEATURE-SPEC/FEATURE-PLAN/FEATURE-TASKS QC reports where those roots are produced, reviewed against accepted main/feature inputs. Scope/count assessments, retained correction cycles and current readiness precede dependent implementation; no whole-project rewrite is inferred.

For each necessary newly created root/proposal, native commit and remote readback precede substantive presentation; the actual human acceptance of that exact presented state, or explicit applicable future-checkpoint preapproval, precedes dependent authoring. PLAN and layout have separate checkpoints; sufficient existing inputs and optional feature overlays retain their scoped rules.

Clarification, comments without acceptance, silence, agent QC and broad Git/development authority do not accept unseen documents. Preserve pending decisions through revisions/interruption; apply the independent checkpoint scenarios in CHECKPOINTS.md. Missing required interaction/order evidence blocks acceptance.

When workflow context is absent or materially changed, the consumer establishes new/existing/interrupted project state, selects/recovers the core workflow/steering variant or scoped standalone operation, and assesses continuation/stage change/switching. Before dependent work, a user-visible chat brief gives the decision, request/project basis, stage/owner, authorized outputs and next checkpoint; internal-only reasoning cannot substitute. Reuse applicable context on routine continuation and preserve pending work/decisions under CHECKPOINTS.md.
